requirements.title: Authenticate
requirements.requirement: The system shall authenticate through an approved identity provider and validate token signature, issuer, audience, expiry and purpose.
requirements.acceptance: Invalid, expired and wrong-audience tokens are denied; legitimate sessions succeed.

requirements.title: Privileged access
requirements.requirement: The system shall require MFA for privileged roles and protect browser sessions against token exposure and request forgery.
requirements.acceptance: Privileged login, session expiry, secure-cookie and CSRF tests pass.

requirements.title: Organization selection
requirements.requirement: The system shall resolve a requested organization against active membership; ambiguous selection shall prompt the user.
requirements.acceptance: A forged tenant selector never grants access; ambiguous selection gives a safe conflict.

requirements.title: Workspace scope
requirements.requirement: The system shall enforce current workspace permission separately from organization membership on every resource path.
requirements.acceptance: Two workspaces in one tenant cannot read each other without explicit membership.

requirements.title: Role separation
requirements.requirement: The system shall separate research, source, legal review, security, audit and publication capabilities.
requirements.acceptance: Each role is denied operations outside its declared permission set.

requirements.title: Revocation
requirements.requirement: The system shall reauthorize long-running jobs, streams, model transmissions, source views and exports after permission changes.
requirements.acceptance: Revocation during a run prevents further unauthorized transmission and final disclosure.

requirements.title: Audit identity changes
requirements.requirement: The system shall record membership, role, policy and permission-revision changes without unnecessary content bodies.
requirements.acceptance: Audit events identify actor, target, time, reason and revision; secrets are absent.

requirements.title: Use-specific rights
requirements.requirement: The system shall store independent decisions for acquisition, storage, parsing, indexing, provider transmission, display, redistribution and training/evaluation.
requirements.acceptance: A source permitted for storage but not model transmission is not sent to a provider.

requirements.title: Fail-closed approval
requirements.requirement: The system shall deny each affected operation while its source permission is pending, rejected, expired or withdrawn.
requirements.acceptance: All non-approved states block the applicable operation and record a safe reason.

requirements.title: Source evidence
requirements.requirement: The source register shall retain rights evidence, access method, attribution, reviewer, review date and re-review or expiry conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Approval cannot be submitted without the required attributable review fields.

requirements.title: Approved acquisition
requirements.requirement: The system shall use reviewed manual imports or approved source adapters with explicit allowlists and rate limits.
requirements.acceptance: Unapproved hosts, protected controls and undocumented acquisition routes cannot be used by the model.

requirements.title: Coverage disclosure
requirements.requirement: The system shall disclose source/court/date coverage, publication cutoff, synchronization status, pending items and material gaps.
requirements.acceptance: A failed synchronization is not presented as an up-to-date corpus.

requirements.title: Immediate restriction
requirements.requirement: The system shall enforce takedowns at serving and transmission boundaries before asynchronous index removal completes.
requirements.acceptance: A newly restricted source cannot be opened, transmitted or used in a new answer.

requirements.title: No synthetic release
requirements.requirement: Production publication shall reject synthetic fixtures, unapproved extractions and unapproved sources.
requirements.acceptance: A candidate containing one synthetic unit fails its publication gate.

requirements.title: Original bytes
requirements.requirement: The system shall preserve the original artifact, byte hash, object version, source locator and acquisition metadata before parsing.
requirements.acceptance: An extracted passage can be traced to an immutable original and its hash.

requirements.title: Version changes
requirements.requirement: The system shall create new artifact/text versions when source bytes or reviewed extraction change, rather than overwrite released evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Same-URL changed bytes produce a new version; earlier runs remain identifiable.

requirements.title: Idempotent import
requirements.requirement: The system shall safely handle repeated imports and queue deliveries with stable job/stage/input keys.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated delivery produces one intended version/effect and auditable attempts.

requirements.title: File safety
requirements.requirement: The system shall validate format, content signature, file limits and scan results before isolated parsing.
requirements.acceptance: Unsafe, unsupported, oversized and corrupt files remain quarantined.

requirements.title: Selective OCR
requirements.requirement: The system shall use native extraction first and record OCR only where required for unusable or image-only pages.
requirements.acceptance: A native-text fixture avoids OCR; a scanned fixture records OCR provenance and review needs.

requirements.title: Legal structure
requirements.requirement: The parser shall preserve provisions, clauses, exceptions, schedules, opinions and original judgment paragraph labels where present.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed fixtures retain essential exceptions and do not invent paragraph numbers.

requirements.title: Exact anchors
requirements.requirement: The system shall retain canonical text, Unicode code-point offsets, page references and optional bounding boxes for source passages.
requirements.acceptance: Quoted spans match canonical text and original visual anchors, including Unicode cases.

requirements.title: Quality review
requirements.requirement: The system shall flag unreadable text, uncertain metadata, essential OCR ambiguities and unresolved legal assertions for review.
requirements.acceptance: Unresolved essential defects cannot advance to authoritative publication.

requirements.title: Atomic publication
requirements.requirement: The system shall validate candidate indexes, manifests and independent approval before activating a corpus release.
requirements.acceptance: Partial indexing or missing approval leaves the candidate unpublished.

requirements.title: Reproducible releases
requirements.requirement: A release shall pin legal units, source-policy, temporal, citation and treatment snapshots with versioned canonical hashes.
requirements.acceptance: A historical run resolves the same approved evidence despite later corrections.

requirements.title: Exact lookup
requirements.requirement: The catalog shall resolve approved titles, canonical IDs and citation aliases without treating a case name as unique.
requirements.acceptance: Ambiguous or unknown identifiers return choices or no verified match.

requirements.title: Structured browsing
requirements.requirement: The viewer shall provide paginated legal-unit navigation and surrounding context without returning an entire corpus.
requirements.acceptance: Long judgments and statutes remain navigable within response size limits.

requirements.title: Canonical quotation
requirements.requirement: The system shall reconstruct quoted text from canonical source spans, never an unchecked search summary or model output.
requirements.acceptance: A modified index excerpt cannot alter the displayed canonical quotation.

requirements.title: Honest pinpoints
requirements.requirement: The viewer shall distinguish original paragraph numbers, PDF page positions and printed page labels.
requirements.acceptance: Unnumbered judgments use page/excerpt references, not fabricated paragraph labels.

requirements.title: Source availability
requirements.requirement: The viewer shall recheck rights and access on every source request and disclose restrictions without substituting authority.
requirements.acceptance: Restricted and missing originals generate a safe availability state.

requirements.title: Context preservation
requirements.requirement: Evidence display shall retain related definitions, provisos, explanations and relevant table headers where material.
requirements.acceptance: A qualifying exception remains visible with its operative provision.

requirements.title: Typed search
requirements.requirement: Search shall accept typed filters and bounded query text, not raw OpenSearch DSL, SQL or client-selected indexes.
requirements.acceptance: Injection and arbitrary-index inputs are rejected.

requirements.title: Parallel retrieval
requirements.requirement: The gateway shall execute lexical and semantic branches using the same mandatory authorized scope.
requirements.acceptance: Integration tests compare mandatory filters in both executed branches.

requirements.title: Private inner filters
requirements.requirement: Private retrieval shall include tenant, workspace, active state and permission revision within candidate selection.
requirements.acceptance: Unauthorized passages never enter model evidence or returned results.

requirements.title: Release pinning
requirements.requirement: Public retrieval shall use the concrete indexes declared in the run’s accessible release.
requirements.acceptance: An alias switch during a run cannot mix release versions.

requirements.title: Rank fusion
requirements.requirement: The system shall fuse candidate ranks deterministically, deduplicate and apply bounded reranking.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated identical candidates produce the same ordering and no duplicates.

requirements.title: Profile compatibility
requirements.requirement: The system shall reject embedding/model/dimension mismatches and require a new evaluated index for profile changes.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong-dimension or wrong-profile requests fail before search/index publication.

requirements.title: Context expansion
requirements.requirement: The retriever shall recover necessary parent context and exceptions within a bounded evidence budget.
requirements.acceptance: An over-budget essential context case is narrowed or qualified, not silently truncated.

requirements.title: Authority distinction
requirements.requirement: The product shall distinguish retrieval relevance from legal authority and preserve court, opinion, scope and treatment metadata.
requirements.acceptance: Recency or similarity alone cannot generate a conclusive precedence label.

requirements.title: Degraded search
requirements.requirement: The system shall expose permitted exact/lexical lookup when generation is unavailable, with explicit service limitations.
requirements.acceptance: A disabled generation provider does not remove healthy catalog functionality.

requirements.title: Research input
requirements.requirement: The system shall capture question, workspace, language, depth, jurisdiction, legal date, authority cutoff, mode and private inclusion explicitly.
requirements.acceptance: Required fields validate against the approved request contract and feature policy.

requirements.title: Bounded clarification
requirements.requirement: The planner shall ask for material missing facts, with at most two clarification rounds before assumptions, narrowing or abstention.
requirements.acceptance: No material state/date/procedural assumption is silently introduced.

requirements.title: Durable run
requirements.requirement: The system shall save plan, release, profiles, policy, evidence and stage progress in a durable research run.
requirements.acceptance: A worker restart recovers a valid checkpoint without fabricating completion.

requirements.title: Budget reservation
requirements.requirement: Research creation shall reserve entitlement/cost allowance and record an outbox event in the same transaction.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent requests cannot exceed a configured allowance through a race.

requirements.title: Evidence handles
requirements.requirement: The coordinator shall assign permitted evidence handles; the model may reference only those handles in material claims.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown, cross-run and cross-release handles are rejected.

requirements.title: Contrary research
requirements.requirement: Research shall seek relevant limiting or contrary material when the question requires synthesis, within declared coverage.
requirements.acceptance: Known adverse-authority test cases are retrieved or explicitly flagged as a coverage gap.

requirements.title: Structured answer
requirements.requirement: Published answers shall distinguish legal authority, user-provided facts, inference, assumptions, limits and review status.
requirements.acceptance: Contract validation and UI tests confirm all applicable sections and source classes.

requirements.title: Safe progress
requirements.requirement: The system shall stream typed milestones and authorized evidence metadata, not unverified legal prose or hidden model reasoning.
requirements.acceptance: Stream payload tests reject raw draft tokens and unauthorized source bodies.

requirements.title: Cancellation
requirements.requirement: The system shall stop new work after cancellation, protect terminal states and reconcile in-flight costs honestly.
requirements.acceptance: Late workers cannot publish after cancellation; uncertain provider charges remain recorded.

requirements.title: Valid abstention
requirements.requirement: Insufficient, conflicted or unverifiable evidence shall yield clarification, qualification, partial output or abstention rather than invented authority.
requirements.acceptance: Critical fake-citation and missing-source fixtures receive the appropriate non-definitive outcome.

requirements.title: Integrity gates
requirements.requirement: Every published citation shall resolve to current authorized evidence within the run and its pinned release.
requirements.acceptance: Every served citation passes run/release/source/permission checks.

requirements.title: Exact quote checks
requirements.requirement: Quoted content shall match the canonical excerpt, Unicode offsets and quote hash exactly.
requirements.acceptance: One-character quotation changes and wrong offsets block publication.

requirements.title: Semantic support
requirements.requirement: The system shall assess whether material claims are supported, including qualifications and passage roles, separately from citation existence.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewer fixtures detect a real citation used for an unsupported proposition.

requirements.title: Bounded repair
requirements.requirement: A failed answer-verification cycle shall allow no more than one controlled repair before omission, review or abstention.
requirements.acceptance: A persistently failing generator cannot enter an unbounded repair loop.

requirements.title: Human review label
requirements.requirement: Only an authenticated qualifying human review operation shall set a lawyer-reviewed status.
requirements.acceptance: Model-supplied review flags are ignored or rejected.

requirements.title: No misleading status
requirements.requirement: The product shall avoid definitive citator or accuracy badges unsupported by corpus coverage and actual review.
requirements.acceptance: A no-adverse-case result includes coverage limitations, not a universal clean-status claim.

requirements.title: Sanitized rendering
requirements.requirement: Answers and citations shall be rendered through safe templates and sanitized content with server-resolved links.
requirements.acceptance: Script URLs, executable HTML and remote-image exfiltration are blocked.

requirements.title: Changed availability
requirements.requirement: When evidence becomes restricted, stored answers shall be limited under policy while retaining an appropriately restricted audit identity.
requirements.acceptance: Old answers show a source-availability notice and do not silently cite a replacement.

requirements.title: Separate dates
requirements.requirement: The system shall distinguish legal applicability, event, authority cutoff, publication and platform knowledge dates.
requirements.acceptance: Tests show that publication date alone does not establish commencement.

requirements.title: Bitemporal records
requirements.requirement: Applicability records shall preserve both legal-time intervals and knowledge-time history with half-open boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: Boundary and retrospective-correction tests execute against actual PostgreSQL.

requirements.title: Scope conditions
requirements.requirement: Version resolution shall consider reviewed territorial, commencement, saving and transitional conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Missing material conditions produce a qualified or review-required result.

requirements.title: Unknown dates
requirements.requirement: Unknown commencement or unresolved scope shall remain explicit and shall block an unqualified operative-law statement.
requirements.acceptance: Null dates cannot be treated as an invented beginning of time.

requirements.title: Historical modes
requirements.requirement: Contemporaneous and retrospective-analysis modes shall apply their distinct authority-cutoff behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Later interpretations are excluded or expressly labeled as required by the chosen mode.

requirements.title: Version comparison
requirements.requirement: The interface shall show selected wording, amendments and evidence-backed relationships without implying automatic section equivalence.
requirements.acceptance: A renumbering fixture retains identity/relationship history and review scope.

requirements.title: Snapshot stability
requirements.requirement: Later corrections shall create new knowledge assertions and release snapshots without rewriting previous research inputs.
requirements.acceptance: The same old run retains its original interpretation inputs while current restrictions remain enforced.

requirements.title: Citation resolution
requirements.requirement: Citation mentions shall retain original text, candidate resolution, ambiguity and review state.
requirements.acceptance: Ambiguous mentions do not become verified cases through model confidence alone.

requirements.title: Opinion attribution
requirements.requirement: The system shall distinguish majority, concurrence, dissent, arguments and quoted prior authority where known.
requirements.acceptance: A dissent or counsel submission cannot be presented as a majority holding.

requirements.title: Treatment evidence
requirements.requirement: Follows, distinguishes, overrules and similar treatment shall have supporting source spans, scoped propositions and review evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A mere citation cannot generate an approved overruling relationship.

requirements.title: Bounded graph
requirements.requirement: Citation-neighbor expansion shall be bounded, release-pinned and reauthorized before use.
requirements.acceptance: Graph traversal respects node/edge limits and excludes restricted evidence.

requirements.title: Conflict reporting
requirements.requirement: The interface shall display potential conflicts and reviewed relationship scope rather than choose controlling authority from a weighted score alone.
requirements.acceptance: A conflicting-authority fixture exposes the conflict and relevant passages.

requirements.title: Private gate
requirements.requirement: The system shall keep private uploads disabled until approved processing, retention and isolation gates pass.
requirements.acceptance: Missing approval denies upload and private model use on the server, not just in the UI.

requirements.title: Upload session
requirements.requirement: Uploads shall use server-issued, constrained destinations with ownership, checksum, media and quota checks.
requirements.acceptance: Object substitution, expiry and overwrite races fail safely.

requirements.title: Isolated parsing
requirements.requirement: Private files shall pass quarantine and sandbox parsing without network or executable document content.
requirements.acceptance: Malicious PDF and resource-exhaustion fixtures remain contained.

requirements.title: Separate private index
requirements.requirement: Private passages shall remain outside public authority indexes and include current tenant/workspace/permission metadata.
requirements.acceptance: No public query can return private passage content or identity.

requirements.title: Source class
requirements.requirement: Private submissions shall be marked as user-provided factual material, not authoritative law.
requirements.acceptance: Answer generation preserves the distinction in mixed public/private evidence.

requirements.title: No training by default
requirements.requirement: Customer content shall not be used for model training by default; any future use requires separate explicit approval and rights.
requirements.acceptance: Provider/configuration tests show training-related routes remain disabled.

requirements.title: Retention-aware deletion
requirements.requirement: Deletion shall revoke ordinary access first, evaluate holds and permitted retention, then track erasure across applicable components.
requirements.acceptance: A held record is restricted; an incompletely erased record is not marked completed.

requirements.title: Restore restrictions
requirements.requirement: Recovery shall replay current deletion, takedown and permission restrictions before restored data are exposed.
requirements.acceptance: A restored backup cannot resurrect searchable deleted/restricted matter content.

requirements.title: Fixed exports
requirements.requirement: Exports shall use fixed safe templates and include dates, source links, release, limitations and actual review status.
requirements.acceptance: Exported citations match the selected answer revision and safe rendering tests pass.

requirements.title: Export authorization
requirements.requirement: The system shall check policy/approval at request, execution and download time.
requirements.acceptance: Revoking membership before download prevents disclosure.

requirements.title: Feedback capture
requirements.requirement: Users shall report answer/source issues against exact revisions with category and optional explanation.
requirements.acceptance: The editorial queue receives a traceable issue without rewriting the original answer.

requirements.title: Correction lineage
requirements.requirement: Corrections shall retain reviewer identity, rationale, affected versions and new release linkage.
requirements.acceptance: A reviewer can reconstruct what changed, why, and which release contains the correction.

requirements.title: No external action
requirements.requirement: Research or export shall not send correspondence, make payment or file court documents.
requirements.acceptance: The available tool/endpoint surface exposes no such autonomous action.

requirements.title: Change notice
requirements.requirement: The product shall surface material availability or correction limitations affecting viewed answers under policy.
requirements.acceptance: Restricted-source and corrected-metadata fixtures display an appropriate notice.

requirements.title: Provider register
requirements.requirement: Every generation, embedding, reranking or external OCR route shall identify approved profile, data classes, processing geography and retention terms.
requirements.acceptance: An unapproved profile or data class fails before transmission.

requirements.title: No silent fallback
requirements.requirement: The system shall fail closed when no approved route exists rather than silently change model, region or content policy.
requirements.acceptance: A provider outage cannot route India-only/private content to an unapproved destination.

requirements.title: Durable queues
requirements.requirement: Workers shall use durable state, leases, heartbeats, bounded retries and dead-letter handling for every background stage.
requirements.acceptance: Crash and duplicate-delivery tests prove recoverability without duplicate effects.

requirements.title: Usage ledger
requirements.requirement: The system shall reconcile reserved, actual and uncertain provider cost against run and tenant allowances.
requirements.acceptance: Timeout and retry tests retain uncertain cost rather than assume zero usage.

requirements.title: Safe observability
requirements.requirement: Logs and traces shall record operational metadata without routine question bodies, private evidence, credentials or full model outputs.
requirements.acceptance: Automated log inspection finds no protected fixture content or secrets.

requirements.title: Operational status
requirements.requirement: Operations views shall expose queue age, source lag, failures, review backlog, budget limits and service degradation.
requirements.acceptance: Induced faults generate actionable alerts and visible states.

requirements.title: Controlled delivery
requirements.requirement: Deployment shall use reviewed infrastructure, pinned dependencies, tested migrations and explicit environment authorization.
requirements.acceptance: A clean release can be reproduced; missing production approval blocks deployment.

requirements.title: Honest completion
requirements.requirement: Implementation reports shall distinguish implemented, tested, blocked, untested and deferred work with actual commands and outputs.
requirements.acceptance: Mock tests, undeployed infrastructure and synthetic fixtures are not reported as production evidence.

requirements.title: Search responsiveness
requirements.requirement: At 100,000 chunks and 10 concurrent researchers on the declared environment, target search p95 below 3 seconds.
requirements.acceptance: Record p50/p95/p99, request count, warm/cold conditions and failed requests.

requirements.title: Quick research
requirements.requirement: On the same declared pilot workload, target quick-research p95 below 60 seconds with approved provider profiles.
requirements.acceptance: Measure the full workflow, including retrieval, provider time and verification.

requirements.title: Availability
requirements.requirement: Target 99.9% monthly production availability after operational validation; define included routes and outage accounting.
requirements.acceptance: Calculate a declared monthly indicator; do not advertise the target as achieved before measurement.

requirements.title: Recovery point
requirements.requirement: Target metadata RPO of 15 minutes with the configured backup/PITR strategy.
requirements.acceptance: A restore drill identifies the recoverable point and actual data loss interval.

requirements.title: Recovery time
requirements.requirement: Target service RTO of 4 hours, with semantic index recovery measured separately and degraded mode documented.
requirements.acceptance: A timed restore/rollback exercise includes access and deletion replay.

requirements.title: Scale qualification
requirements.requirement: Test 100,000 chunks for pilot and 1 million before broad-corpus release.
requirements.acceptance: Report index size, recall, latency, concurrency, cost and rebuild duration.

requirements.title: Citation integrity
requirements.requirement: Every served citation must pass current identity, source, release and access checks.
requirements.acceptance: Per-answer deterministic gate plus adversarial cross-run/release/permission fixtures.

requirements.title: Quotation integrity
requirements.requirement: Every served quotation must exactly match its canonical approved span.
requirements.acceptance: Unicode, ligature/extraction, offset and tampered-quote tests pass.

requirements.title: Retrieval quality
requirements.requirement: Proposed Recall@20 at least 0.90 on lawyer-annotated relevant authorities.
requirements.acceptance: Report dataset size, denominator, category breakdown and uncertainty, with held-out separation.

requirements.title: Claim support
requirements.requirement: Proposed at least 95% of substantive claims supported on independent review, with no unresolved critical defect.
requirements.acceptance: Review claim-level support and qualifications; real citations alone do not count as support.

requirements.title: Contrary evidence
requirements.requirement: Proposed at least 90% recall on annotated known adverse/limiting-authority cases.
requirements.acceptance: Report the known-reference denominator and corpus coverage; do not claim a complete citator.

requirements.title: Scope and temporal safety
requirements.requirement: Zero known critical wrong-version, wrong-jurisdiction or opinion-attribution failures in the release suite.
requirements.acceptance: Boundary, unknown commencement, dissent and saving/transitional fixtures pass.

requirements.title: Tenant confidentiality
requirements.requirement: Zero unauthorized content or source identity exposure in the declared isolation test suite.
requirements.acceptance: Check results, provider payloads, logs, events, caches, exports and restore behavior.

requirements.title: Bounded execution
requirements.requirement: All requests, tools, retries, files and provider calls shall obey configured time, size, cost and concurrency limits.
requirements.acceptance: Adversarial loops and oversized files terminate safely with correct usage status.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.requirement: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for enabled user journeys, subject to audit; provide keyboard navigation and accessible source text.
requirements.acceptance: Automated checks plus manual keyboard, screen-reader, focus and contrast review.

requirements.title: Usability
requirements.requirement: A new user shall be able to ask a question and locate its cited passage without technical terminology being required.
requirements.acceptance: Observed pilot tasks capture success, time, confusion and actionable findings.

requirements.title: Maintainability
requirements.requirement: Use modular boundaries, pinned dependencies, schema versioning and documented configuration; no hard-coded secrets or source hosts.
requirements.acceptance: Clean-clone setup, contract drift checks, migration tests and dependency review pass.

requirements.title: Security launch gate
requirements.requirement: No unresolved critical/high security finding may remain for the enabled production scope.
requirements.acceptance: Independent security evidence, remediation and regression results are recorded.

requirements.title: Observability and privacy
requirements.requirement: Operational diagnosis shall be possible through safe identifiers and metrics without routine private payload logging.
requirements.acceptance: A fault investigation succeeds using permitted logs; protected fixture text is absent.

requirements.title: Reproducibility
requirements.requirement: Research history shall preserve release, source, model/prompt, policy and verification identity, subject to current restrictions.
requirements.acceptance: A stored run’s evidence and configuration can be reconstructed without silently altering it.

workflows.title: Sign in and select a research workspace
Ask a question and receive a checked answer
Search for a provision or judgment without AI generation
Open a citation and inspect its support
Research the law applicable at a historical date
Import, review and publish legal material
Use a private document in a matter
Request and download a research memorandum
Correct a source or report a misleading answer
Revoke access or delete private matter data
Handle interruption, duplicate delivery and cancellation
Release a tested version and recover from a fault

acceptance_scenarios: An authorized researcher enters a workspace; expired/wrong-audience tokens fail.
A supplied foreign tenant/workspace ID returns no protected data or existence detail.
A known fixture provision opens its exact text and original page.
An invented or ambiguous citation does not become a fabricated verified case.
The final answer links each substantive legal proposition to supporting run evidence.
The system asks a focused clarification, then records assumptions or abstains within its limit.
The product returns an honest evidence-limited result, not a guessed authority.
A one-character quote change fails deterministic checks and cannot be published as an exact quote.
A valid citation with unsupported analysis fails claim-support review.
No unqualified operative-law conclusion appears when the effective date is unresolved.
The synthetic version ending at a boundary is excluded on that boundary date.
Contemporaneous and retrospective modes treat a later decision differently and visibly.
Repeated delivery yields one intended import/version effect with attempt history.
New bytes create a new version without altering earlier evidence.
The document remains under review/quarantine and does not become published authority.
A production release containing a synthetic fixture is rejected.
Unapproved private processing prevents upload and provider transmission.
A malicious/oversized/unsupported PDF remains isolated and unavailable for research.
Removed workspace access blocks further private transmission, final publication and streams.
Uploaded case facts are labeled as private material, not legislation or a court holding.
An export requires policy approval and fresh authorization at download.
Serving is blocked immediately and earlier answers show appropriate availability limits.
Access is withdrawn, held material is restricted, and erasure status is accurate.
A durable checkpoint resumes safely without duplicate answer publication.
No unapproved fallback occurs; healthy catalog functionality remains available.
A late worker cannot publish after cancellation; uncertain external cost is retained.
Document instructions cannot grant tools, disclose secrets or cross scope.
No new chargeable action begins after the permitted allowance is exhausted.
Restoration replays restrictions before reopening; deleted/restricted data is not searchable.
An unresolved critical legal/security defect blocks launch despite passing average metrics.
